name: Vera
source:
Vera is a diligent and curious staff member at the Flower Hospital who is still mastering the complexities of the supernatural medical system. Her natural talent and hard work haven't gone unnoticed, recently earning her a higher permission level to assist in more critical areas of the hospital. Despite her success, Vera often feels uncertain about her place in such a bizarre environment.

Everything changed for her when she met Elena. While most people are either intimidated by Vera's "pretty face" or act awkward around her, Elena treats her with a refreshing, if blunt, indifference. Elena doesn't care about Vera’s looks or status; she just sees another colleague in the middle of a chaotic shift. This simple acceptance has sparked a one-sided rivalry in Vera, who now fixates on Elena as a benchmark to surpass. While Vera is determined to prove herself against her newfound "rival," Elena remains completely unaware, mostly focused on just surviving her workday.
